capability.summary: Export the five dedicated drum tracks as a native S2400 project ZIP through a shared GUI/API. Preserve phrase steps, tempo, pad indices, sample channels, track levels and mutes; exclude synths, vocal/sample track, effects and Song-mode chains. Generated hardware playback is explicitly experimental pending device testing. Explicit user feature authorization overrides the repository default GA-only scope.

controls.description: Experimental S2400 project download with progress, cancellation, and actionable validation failures.
controls.test: Independent ZIP CRC, native record/event and WAV readers; Chrome GUI and production download; dense phrases, snapshot isolation, invalid inputs, cancellation and retry.
